measurement_notes: Only existing ProductionModel and AI; orchestration inherits production_simulations.gd setup, full turns and actual observations. No engine/card/rule/policy edits.
32 legal30-card decks collectively include550 IDs; membership never means actual play. Successful play counts come only from observed policy commands.
All64 directed pairs and256 seeds/first sides are written to a separate frozen plan before the first complete duel. Opening-only seed probes are excluded from played-game totals.
Every planned game is retained, including errors/censors; no chosen replacement winner and no silent case removal. Max500 hero policy calls is a technical stop, not a draw rule.
Eight repeats and four fresh constructors are separate controls, never added to matrix coverage or headline256 games. Determinism excludes only measured wall time.
Generic effect counts come from actual runtime effect/status entries, not printed abilities. Native event-kind counts are observed traces, not exhaustive per-handler coverage.
Energy is observed action-phase availability/printed successful play costs/end residue; resonance is net per action, not complete gross accounting. Peaks are observed boundaries.
Wall time measures setup/opening/real match until finish returns, before report aggregation; shared hardware/load makes this a sample, not a benchmark guarantee.
Journal flushes each completed attempt. An externally interrupted run retains its frozen plan and actual finished attempts; unrun cases must remain explicitly unrun.
Heuristic self-play samples interactions/performance; neither550 played identities nor all interactions/human balance are guaranteed.
